channel_comparability: Same packet and exact text prompt across both contracts within provider. Groq strict JSON schema vs JSON object; Gemini response_json_schema vs JSON MIME. Cross-provider formats are not identical interventions.
note: These two pilot task IDs are disjoint from main tasks; merely authored siblings, not independent ecologies.
order: Fixed local Random seed 690069+model_index; all cells shuffle; no server seed claimed.
provider_auto_retry: Groq SDK max_retries=0; Gemini SDK retry behavior not established and separately logged as unknown.
primary_readiness_gate: Every model×channel needs >=36/48 provider responses, >=36/48 format-valid, >=1 grounded valid witness and >=1 correct null abstention. No adaptive retest.
sample_excluded_from_paper: All pilot outputs are instrumentation-only; no p-value or scientific effect promotion.
manual_execution_rule: Pilot workflow_dispatch requires P69 canary workflow actual provider run_id, event workflow_dispatch, successful MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT_READY artifact and identical HEAD SHA. PUSH triggers only zero-call preflight.
scientific_main_gate: Separate paper construct gates: independent human source adjudication, independent genuinely new mechanism ecologies, prespecified clustered inference, external source task semantics, and distinct model provider results. Do not automatically launch main.
security: Never upload secrets or private annotation key; provider output here synthetic task packets. Read-only workflow, no git push, bot commits forbidden.
approval: workflow_dispatch requires user explicit action; no GitHub Actions bot authorship.
